requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Ink Bottles with Increased Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop and integrate new NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield, with CMY bottle size >8K.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance ink capacity, reduce frequency of replacement, and support higher page yield requirements for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with IDS, compatibility with SuperAmp PHA, reuse of Magi/Nessie ink.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink bottles must be keyed, support 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield, and CMY bottle size must be greater than 8K. Bottles must be compatible with existing systems and pass reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure the new NGB keyed bottles provide spill-free reliability during user handling and installation.
requirements.Rationale: To minimize customer complaints and warranty costs due to ink spills, and to improve user experience.
requirements.Dependencies: NGB Keyed Ink Bottles design and manufacturing quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles must meet defined spill-free reliability metrics in lab and field tests.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Design the NOA-F (Non-Original Accessory-Filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth and a lid label, maintaining compatibility with push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: To improve the reliability and security of the NOA-F, and to maintain compatibility with existing mechanisms.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F design, push-push and TDF mechanism compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F must include a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, and pass compatibility and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Reuse of SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Reuse the existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without ink reformulation in the new product.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage proven technology, reduce development time, and minimize cost.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new ink bottles and NOA-F.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks must function without reformulation in the new system and meet performance criteria.

requirements.Title: Enhanced Reliability and Characterization Modeling
requirements.Description: Perform reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), Air gain, flow rate, and IDS characterization and modeling, including startup and NOA-F EOL (End of Life).
requirements.Rationale: To ensure robust product performance and predictability throughout the product lifecycle.
requirements.Dependencies: Access to test data, finalized component designs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Models must be completed, validated, and reviewed with documented results for startup and EOL scenarios.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling for Tank and PQ Impact
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in the tank and assess its impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: To ensure consistent print quality and prevent ink degradation over time.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Documented ink stability models and PQ impact assessment report.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts for Warranty Support
requirements.Description: Provide NOA-F as service parts to support warranty claims and maintenance.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure serviceability and support for customers during warranty period.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F must be available as service parts and tracked in warranty support systems.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 technology on the ink bottle lid.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance product security, authentication, or user experience (context-dependent; Acumen 6 likely refers to a security or smart feature).
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 feature must be present on the lid and function as intended in system tests.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 line for NOA-F, add Magi ink cart and labelling tool in Orcus 5, and mold for 1 to 4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: To enable manufacturing of new components and ensure efficient production.
requirements.Dependencies: Finalized designs for NOA-F, ink cart, and caps.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Factory lines modified, tools added, and production validated for new components.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer-Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the system so that PHA (Printhead Assembly) and NOA-F are customer-replaceable.
requirements.Rationale: To improve serviceability and reduce downtime for users.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, Service Teams, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PHA and NOA-F can be replaced by customers with provided instructions and without specialized tools.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Set the new warranty page life goal to 80,000 pages for the product.
requirements.Rationale: To meet market and customer expectations for durability and cost-effectiveness.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, Warranty Teams, End Users
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System must reliably print at least 80,000 pages under warranty conditions.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Implement Reddington ID with a size increase for the ink tank, without changing Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: To accommodate higher ink volume without redesigning other major components.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and chassis design, Reddington ID integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Reddington ID present, tank size increased, no changes to Marconi-HI ADF, and system passes fit and function tests.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for the product.
requirements.Rationale: To protect the product during shipping and handling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: EPS foam packaging designed, tested, and implemented for all shipments.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure the product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel requirements for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: To comply with environmental and regulatory standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product receives EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certifications for PDL SKU.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to align with the new tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure mechanical compatibility and minimize product footprint.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays redesigned and validated for fit and function with new tank configuration.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch color graphic display (CGD) into the product.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance user interface and usability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD display integrated and passes usability and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: 4-Tube Platform with New Routing and Integration
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes and implement new tube routing and integration for a 4-tube platform.
requirements.Rationale: To optimize ink delivery and system reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4-tube system implemented, new routing validated for performance and reliability.

requirements.Title: Aerosol Management in Service Station
requirements.Description: Implement aerosol management in the service station with spit platform changes due to the tank.
requirements.Rationale: To minimize environmental and internal contamination from ink aerosols.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol management features implemented and validated in service station tests.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model with Tube and New Weights
requirements.Description: Develop carriage dynamic and force models considering new tube routing and increased component weights.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure mechanical robustness and print quality with new system configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Dynamic and force models completed and reviewed, system passes mechanical stress tests.

requirements.Title: Paperpath Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign the paperpath to support increased page life targets.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliable operation throughout the extended product lifecycle.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paperpath redesigned and validated for 80k page life target.

requirements.Title: Serviceable Ink Maintenance Part Post 80k Life
requirements.Description: Provide a serviceable ink maintenance part (at Service Center) for use after 80,000-page life.
requirements.Rationale: To extend product usability and reduce total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Stakeholders: Service Teams, End Users, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Serviceable part available and service procedure documented for post-80k maintenance.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection in IDS
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and fluidic interface (FI) connections in the IDS (Ink Delivery System).
requirements.Rationale: To support new ink bottle and tank designs and improve reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS design, ink bottle and tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New make-break and FI connections implemented and validated in system tests.

requirements.Title: LEBI Ink-Tank with Increased Size, Keying, and LOI SHAID
requirements.Description: Leverage LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI (Level of Ink) SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: To improve ink management, prevent misinstallation, and enhance user experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: LEBI ink-tank implemented with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID, passing validation tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new startup algorithm and air management for the IDS to support the new ink system.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliable system startup and prevent air-related failures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New algorithm implemented, system passes startup and air management tests.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm for WS
requirements.Description: Implement new servicing and startup algorithms for the WS (likely Waste System or similar subsystem).
requirements.Rationale: To improve system reliability and reduce maintenance needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New algorithms implemented and validated in system tests.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Metrics
requirements.Description: Define and implement new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion metrics to align with the new page yield definition.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure the product meets updated performance expectations and customer requirements.
requirements.Dependencies: PQ goal definition, depletion metric modeling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New PQ goals and depletion metrics documented and validated in system tests.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU in the new product.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce cost and leverage proven hardware components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Components reused without modification and pass system integration tests.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module into the product.
requirements.Rationale: To provide wireless connectivity for modern user needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Stingray Wi-Fi module integrated and passes connectivity and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Dune Firmware Integration
requirements.Description: Use Dune firmware in the new product.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage existing firmware capabilities and reduce development time.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Dune firmware integrated and passes all functional and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in both hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance product security and protect against unauthorized access or tampering.
requirements.Stakeholders: Security Teams, R&D, Product Management, End Users
requirements.Dependencies: Security feature integration in HW and FW.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Gauss4.xx security features implemented and validated in security tests.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS and SMB Solution Integration
requirements.Description: Support Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) and SMB (Small and Medium Business) solution integration, including onboarding via Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP paths.
requirements.Rationale: To address new business models and support a wide range of customer segments.
requirements.Stakeholders: Business Teams, Product Management, End Users, SMB Customers
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS and SMB solutions integrated, onboarding paths validated in system tests.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution and Enterprise Support Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solutions and enterprise support tools including WJA, HPSM, and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: To provide comprehensive functionality for enterprise customers.
requirements.Stakeholders: Enterprise Customers, Product Management, IT Teams
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Scan solution and enterprise support tools integrated and validated in enterprise environment tests.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support for HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD
requirements.Description: Ensure support for a broad range of clients and drivers including HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD.
requirements.Rationale: To maximize compatibility and ease of use for diverse customer environments.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, IT Teams, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers supported and validated in system tests.

requirements.Title: Schedule Adherence and SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K
requirements.Description: Adhere to defined schedule and ensure SuperAmp PHA life is at least 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To meet business commitments and ensure component reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Project milestones met on schedule, SuperAmp PHA life validated at 65k pages.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years or Page Life (Optimized)
requirements.Description: Ensure product warranty covers 2 years or specified page life, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: To align with customer expectations and competitive market offerings.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, Warranty Teams, End Users
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms clearly defined, product meets either 2-year or page life target.

requirements.Title: Throughput of 25/20 PPM (PDL)
requirements.Description: Achieve a print throughput of 25 pages per minute (ppm) and 20 ppm for PDL (Page Description Language) mode.
requirements.Rationale: To meet performance expectations for target segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product consistently achieves 25/20 ppm in standard tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability of Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Ensure the maintenance box is easily serviceable to reduce downtime and maintenance costs.
requirements.Rationale: To improve user experience and reduce service costs.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, Service Teams, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance box design, service procedure documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be serviced by users or service personnel with minimal effort and tools.
